WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_qty,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_total_cost <> 0 THEN (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE ili.order_item_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_qty,
    avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_qty IS NULL, avg_qty DESC) as rank
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_qty,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY product_color, rank
